text:
Silver Price in 2015
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2015, the LBMA silver price fell 18.3% between 2015-01-30 ($16.92) and 2015-12-31 ($13.82). The highest sampled price was $16.92 in January and the lowest was $13.82 in December. The mean of these observations was $15.51. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2015:
A strong US dollar and expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes pushed gold to multi-year lows.
